metadata.title: How To Do A Title Search On A Property Yourself Before You Bid At Tax Sale Auctions
metadata.author: Ted Thomas
metadata.shortDescription:
Ted Thomas talks about How To Do A Title Search On A Property Yourself Before You Bid At Tax Sale Auctions? Watch to understand more about this process!
Claim your free gift at https://tedthomas.com/ytl-31069/

Key Moments In This Episode:
00:00 Intro
0:44 Learning How To Research Properties Is a Must
1:45 You Need To Learn Basic Research Before You Bid
